description: Two screenshot locales, a recapture marker, and no Playwright MCP server to capture with: resolve-markers keeps the marker and leaves both the UA and the EN image as they were, so no locale is half-updated.
setup:
printf 'OPERATOR_BASE_URL=https://test.example.com
OPERATOR_USERNAME=tester
OPERATOR_PASSWORD=secret
' > .env && printf '.env
' >> .gitignore && printf '%s
' '- **Admin UI:** playwright' '- **Screenshot locales:** `uk, en`' '- **Locale switch:** `url-prefix uk=/, en=/en/`' >> CLAUDE.md && mkdir -p portal/transactions/.assets i18n/en/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs-portal/current/transactions/.assets && printf 'uk image' > portal/transactions/.assets/filters-pane.png && printf 'en image' > i18n/en/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs-portal/current/transactions/.assets/filters-pane.png

perl -0pi -e 's/(Список оновлюється автоматично\.)/$1

![Панель фільтрів](./.assets/filters-pane.png)
{/* ToDo: recapture screenshot — the filters pane changed */}/' portal/transactions/transactions.md && grep -q 'recapture screenshot' portal/transactions/transactions.md
